name: 行数统计
description: 快速看某表行数,基础健康检查。

name: 重复主键检测
description: 找出违反主键唯一约束的数据。GROUP BY + HAVING 经典写法。

name: 字段空值分布
description: 看某字段的空值率,数据补齐 / 字段必填检查。
sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ${col} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_count,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ${col} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS null_pct
FROM ${table};

name: 按日趋势
description: 时间字段按天聚合,做趋势分析。MySQL 用 DATE();Oracle 用 TRUNC()。

name: 分组 Top N
description: 找某分组下值最大的 N 条。窗口函数,需要 MySQL 8+ / Oracle 12c+。
sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT t.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ${group_col} ORDER BY ${order_col} DESC) AS rn
  FROM ${table} t
) sub
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY ${group_col}, rn;

name: EXPLAIN 看慢 SQL
